gap: Acceptance check for A: every downtown tower 1-3 km away must show readable facade detail (window grids or mullions, glass vs. concrete variation, rooftop equipment, different tones per building). The towers must also fade with distance, nearer ones darker and higher-contrast than farther ones, so that at least 3 separate depth layers of the city can be read and no tower looks like a flat one-tone box.

Route frame 09 gives the same result: far towers 0.80/0.76/0.71, near land 0.48/0.46/0.45. Caveat: the haze is a near-white veil. - Timing: the work finished at 09:00 UTC, before this wave's 09:05 end.. Judge: The AAA frame (pair-1 B, pair-2 A, pair-3 A, pair-4 A) won all four pairs. The gap was very large in pairs 1 and 3, large in pair 2, and clear but smaller in pair 4. The in-development frames fail the same way each time. Skyline towers are pale, nearly untextured boxes, and water and ground are flat planes with no reflections, ripples, grime or wear. Haze barely grades the scene with distance: near areas stay equally crisp, then the skyline suddenly turns bleached. There is almost no traffic, no pedestrians and no boats. Props are evenly spaced copies, and landmarks are set out like a checklist rather than built into a lived-in city. Lighting is mostly neutral and overcast-flat. There is also a white bloom-disc artifact on the water, and the helicopter rotors have no motion blur. The best in-development frame is the ground-level street shot (pair-4 B): warm low sun, long shadows, good canopy trees and a decent character. Even there, an empty, untextured street takes up almost half the frame. In priority order, the fixes are: facade materials and tonal variation on towers; steady haze fall-off with distance; water shading with skyline reflections, glitter and boats; then traffic and pedestrians, breaking up repetition and the perfect grid, and removing the bloom orb. The AAA frames that genuinely wow are the backlit hillside sign (pair 1), the hazy helicopter flyover (pair 2) and the dusk police helicopter with its searchlight (pair 3). The golf-course frame is polished but not a wow, and none of the in-development frames wow.
